name: Warhammer Fantasy Classics
summary: Warhammer Fantasy Classics bundle is a collection of some of the greatest titles from the history of Warhammer Fantasy video games, spanning the past 30 years. These games have been brought back to life as a series to celebrate their iconic legacy. Revived in a form that stays close to their original releases. Because of their classic nature, some content may not fully reflect current depictions, lore, or presentation within the modern Warhammer Fantasy universe.
